title: No choice but to succeed: how MMC Search Partners bet on itself
summary: Michael Crescenzo started MMC Search Partners with two clients and a laptop. On Contrario, his team has made 20+ placements and $850K+ in revenue.
body_markdown:
Michael first spoke with Arya in June 2025, when Contrario was three months old. He said yes because of the founders.


“Arya and Adi’s character and vision were so genuine and driven,” he says. “They weren’t just asking for advice, they were implementing it. They weren’t afraid to be upfront about where their knowledge was lacking.”


Contrario gave MMC a steady flow of roles at venture-backed startups with no business development needed, plus AI agents that support every search: one scores every candidate against a role’s requirements, green flags and red flags before submission, and ReAgent resurfaces strong past candidates for new roles. In Michael’s words, recruiters can “surface opportunities with a single click.” MMC started with sales and growth roles and built out Contrario’s hiring in New York.
